item.title: A plastic once thought harmless may be fueling fatty liver disease
item.description:
📝 Texas A&M researchers discovered that polyethylene microplastics can contribute to fatty liver disease, with potentially worse effects when combined with an unhealthy diet. Their findings suggest that polyethylene microplastics may contribute to fatty liver disease, particularly when exposure occurs alongside an unhealthy diet. " Common Microplastics May Contribute to Fatty Liver Disease To investigate the possible health effects of polyethylene, Joshi and his colleagues examined whether exposure to this common plastic could promote fatty liver disease.
🔗 Read more: https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/10/261008102718.htm
